response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff-level individual contributor with broad full-stack, backend, and open-source experience, but he has no executive or CTO-level leadership track record, no evidence of scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+, no fintech-domain ownership (credit risk, working-capital, compliance), and only surface-level exposure to agentic AI (MCP tooling) rather than production multi-agent system architecture. The role requires 10+ years with 5+ in senior technical leadership, team-scaling experience, and deep fintech/agentic-AI production ownership, none of which are demonstrated here.
strengths: Broad, deep technical versatility across languages, platforms, and systems (web, mobile, embedded, distributed)
Some current exposure to agentic AI tooling (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks)
Strong engineering craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source leadership, teaching/workshops
concerns: No demonstrated people-leadership or team-scaling experience (10→30+ engineers) required for this executive role
No fintech-specific domain experience in credit risk, working-capital allocation, or regulatory compliance
No evidence of production multi-agent AI system design/ownership at the architectural or executive level

key_factors.factor: Lack of executive/leadership scaling track record
